findings: R1.1/R1.3 (S3): RunAccounting.checkpoint writes report.json in the final RunReport shape plus checkpoint {last_completed_station, elapsed_ms, usage_so_far=summarize_steps(steps)} after every station, including the early-break paths (intake stop, budget, packet limit, station stop, checks stop) and the loop tail for completed and skipped stations. It adds no station and no model call. The final report is built with checkpoint=acct.last_checkpoint plus the exit fields. Tests test_s3_checkpoints_accumulate_during_healthy_run and test_s3_final_report_is_last_checkpoint_plus_verdict pass.

R1.2/R2.5 (S6): write_report_atomic uses tempfile.mkstemp in the run dir, then fsync and os.replace. The temp file is unlinked in finally, a failure goes to stderr and the prior report.json stays. All former direct report.json writes in runner.py, including the status-page warning rewrite, now go through it. test_s6_* pass.

R2.1/R2.2 (S1, S2, S5, S8): EXIT_STATUSES matches the closed set exactly. _station_stop covers budget (cap or runtime threshold), timed_out and error_max_turns. The pre-review checks gate stop with no loopback left gives checks_stopped, and a pre-deploy gate_failed is mapped too. Intake rejected/waiting_info and knowledge-pack failure give intake_stopped. The run_pipeline wrapper's record_exit covers uncaught exceptions (error, with type and message) and RunSignal/KeyboardInterrupt (signal, SIGTERM/SIGINT). It still marks state crashed and re-raises or exits 128+signum. Each termination_reason names the station and limit as the spec requires.

R2.3/R2.4 (S1): _not_run_steps names each unreached pipeline station once with status not_run. The in-flight station is recorded with its honest executed model only while the runtime is being called. The cost section is unchanged (RunReport.to_dict builds it from measured steps only), so cost-measurement semantics hold. budget_death carries measured_tokens, max_run_tokens, station_in_flight and station_usage, or station_usage_reason when no usage was exposed.

R3.1/R3.3 (S4, S7): render_swimlane renders from a report dict alone and treats every key as optional. tools/line_comment.py adds Exit status, Termination reason and a last-checkpoint line only when those keys are present, so legacy reports render unchanged. anvil/line.py load_resume reports a non-completed exit_status record as the run's accounting. R3.2: history preservation (runner.py around line 1489) runs before acct is wired and before any checkpoint, and test_s4_later_run_preserves_killed_record_in_history passes.
